name: Grizzlepaw Ridge
summary: Bears claim Grizzlepaw Ridge, the rough hills south of Thelsamar in Loch Modan. Ol' Sooty prowls among them, feared by local hunters.

sections.title: Home of the Bears
sections.body: Grizzlepaw Ridge rises above the road south of Thelsamar, with Stonesplinter Valley along its western edge. Territorial bears claim the rough slopes and threaten travelers who skirt the mountains. Deep within the ridge lives Ol' Sooty, a massive, unusually fierce bear feared by local hunters. Travelers between the dwarven settlements watch the tree line and rocky terraces above.

aliases: how to get to grizzlepaw ridge
faq.answer: Grizzlepaw Ridge lies in Loch Modan's central hills, directly south of Thelsamar and east of Stonesplinter Valley.

faq.q: What dangerous creatures live on Grizzlepaw Ridge?
faq.answer: Aggressive bears roam Grizzlepaw Ridge. The most infamous is Ol' Sooty, an exceptionally large and ferocious beast that sometimes prowls toward the mountain base.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can track wild beasts on Grizzlepaw Ridge and face apex predators like Ol' Sooty.
As a dwarf, you know the bears on the ridge beside Thelsamar trouble local mountaineers and supply routes.
